name: El Catllar (Spain)
description: Green field with a white cross throughout charged with a narrower red cross, itself charged with a thin white cross.
history: The official flag of El Catllar is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with three full crosses superimposed, white, red and white, of arms of thickness 3/9, 2/9 and 1/9 of the height of the cloth; published in the DOGC on 30 April 1999 and rectified on 6 February 2015.

features.role: narrower cross of 2/9 over the white
thin cross of 1/9 over the red
